item.title: 'No reason to go elsewhere': Zerodha CEO Nithin Kamath welcomes SEBI's NRI KYC changes
item.description: Zerodha CEO Nithin Kamath welcomed SEBI’s eased digital KYC rules for overseas investors, saying eligible NRIs and OCIs can now complete account opening from abroad in days instead of weeks. The change takes effect December 3, 2026, and could help attract more long-term investment to India.

item.title: Why Asian AI stocks tumbled after US midterm results as Kospi plunged over 5%; key reasons explained
item.description: South Korea’s Kospi fell 5.3% as technology and semiconductor shares sold off, prompting temporary trading restrictions. Asian markets also declined amid concerns that Democratic gains in US midterm elections could bring tighter limits on AI data centres and pressure to curb military spending.

item.title: Maharashtra state discom targets February 2027 IPO, aims to raise over ₹10,000 crore
item.description: Maharashtra's state-run power distributor plans to file its prospectus by December, following a restructuring that includes the demerger of its agricultural business and a ₹32,679 crore debt takeover by the state government.

item.title: Muhurat Trading 2026: How has the Indian stock market performed over the past 10 years? What lies ahead in Samvat 2083
item.description: India’s stock exchanges will hold Diwali Muhurat Trading on November 8, continuing a tradition seen as auspicious by investors. The session has historically closed higher in eight of the past 10 years.&nbsp;

item.title: Titan shines in Q2 Results 2026; Net profit doubles to ₹2,393 crore, aided by one-time gain; jewellery business up 24%
item.description: Titan reported a 113% year-on-year rise in September-quarter net profit to ₹2,393 crore, including a ₹671 crore one-time gain. Revenue grew 25% to ₹20,533 crore, led by jewellery, watches and eyewear, while strong demand for studded jewellery improved the product mix.

item.title: Bharti Airtel Q2 results: Profit jumps 31% to ₹8,888 crore, ARPU up ₹271 crore, telco stock rallies 121% in 3 yrs
item.description: Bharti Airtel reported a 31% annual increase in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹8,888 crore, while revenue rose 16.7% to ₹60,877.5 crore. ARPU climbed 6% to ₹271, supported by growth in 4G and 5G users.

item.title: Sebi allows mutual fund schemes to net cash market fund settlements
item.description: Sebi’s move changes the treatment of fund obligations for eligible mutual fund transactions, without altering the requirement for securities to be settled on a gross basis.

item.title: Terrific Thursday for stock market! Nifty jumps 576 pts, Sensex 2,009 pts after US election results; bank, IT shares fly
item.description: Indian equities rose for a sixth straight session, with the Sensex gaining 2.6% and the Nifty 2.4% in their biggest single-day advances in seven months. Lower crude prices renewed foreign buying and hopes of geopolitical de-escalation supported the rally.&nbsp;

item.title: Gold Price Prediction: After 20% crash, Gold may rise 20–25% by Dhanteras 2027; check price forecast - Buy or wait?
item.description: Gold’s correction of more than 20% from its January 2026 peak may offer long-term investors an opportunity to accumulate gradually. Central-bank buying and renewed ETF inflows could support a recovery, while high interest rates, a stronger US dollar and geopolitical uncertainty remain risks.

item.title: 168% rally in 3 yrs: After ₹270 dividend, auto ancillary stock to consider bonus, stock split - Do you own?
item.description: Bosch shares rose 3.25% on Thursday after the company said its board would consider a stock split and bonus issue at its November 6 meeting. The stock has gained 17.21% in a month. Earlier this year, Bosch announced a dividend of ₹270 per share.

item.title: Ashok Leyland shares jump over 10% in biggest single-day gain since April; here's what lifted the stock
item.description: The rally in Ashok Leyland followed a sharp overnight retreat in crude oil prices, while expectations of a possible easing of US trade tariffs after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in the US midterm elections lifted Dalal Street sentiment.

item.title: Samvat 2083 Outlook Ahead of Diwali, Muhurat Trading: Nifty at 27,000 soon? What Choice Wealth's Dheeraj said - Strategy
item.description: Choice Wealth expects the Nifty to reach 26,500–27,000 and the Sensex 86,000–88,000 over 12 months, supported by resilient growth and earnings. Elevated oil prices and geopolitical tensions remain key risks. The firm favors large-caps, with selective exposure to healthcare and financial services.
